paper.title: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
paper.summary: Memory expertise is a learned skill: knowing what to encode, when to retrieve, and how to organize knowledge--a capacity known in cognitive science as metamemory. We bring this perspective to LLMs by treating memory management as a trainable skill. We promote file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, letting the model itself decide how to manage its memory. This memory skill improves along two axes: the structure that supports it (prompts, file schemas, action vocabulary), and the proficiency of the model exercising it. Both axes resist manual optimization: episodes in long-horizon tasks run for thousands of steps, and a single memory mistake can hide long before it surfaces, making human review of full trajectories impractical. We introduce AutoMem, a framework that automates both axes. In the first loop, a strong LLM reviews complete agent trajectories and iteratively revises the memory structure that shapes how the agent interacts with its memory files. In the second loop, the agent's own good memory decisions are identified from many episodes and used as training signal to sharpen the model's memory proficiency directly. Across three procedurally generated long-horizon games (Crafter, MiniHack, and NetHack), optimizing memory alone--without modifying the model's task-action behavior--improved the base agent's performance ~2x-4x, bringing a 32B open-weight model competitive with frontier systems such as Claude Opus 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking. Our results show that memory management is an independently learnable skill, and a high-leverage objective yielding large gains on long-horizon tasks.
paper.ai_summary: Memory management in large language models is treated as a trainable skill through a framework that automates both memory structure optimization and proficiency enhancement, leading to significant performance improvements in long-horizon tasks.

paper.title: AnyGroundBench: A Specialized-Domain Benchmark for Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
paper.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated immense promise in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG). However, current evaluation protocols are largely confined to zero-shot assessments on general, daily-life benchmarks. This creates a critical disconnect from real-world applications in specialized fields, where models inevitably encounter rare visual concepts and complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Since exhaustive pre-training across infinite data distributions is infeasible, the ability to adapt to novel domains is essential. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnyGroundBench, a domain-adaptation benchmark designed to shift the STVG evaluation paradigm from static zero-shot testing to rigorous domain adaptation. Targeting five specialized domains (animal, industry, sports, surgery, and public security), AnyGroundBench pairs newly captured videos such as expert-annotated mouse behaviors with established datasets, unifying them through dense, high-fidelity spatio-temporal annotations. Crucially, the benchmark provides dedicated training subsets to systematically measure domain adaptability. We extensively evaluate 15 state-of-the-art VLMs, assessing their zero-shot generalization and In-Context Learning (ICL) capabilities under practical computational constraints. Ultimately, our findings reveal that current models fail in both zero-shot and ICL-based adaptation when confronted with specialized domains, exposing critical flaws in spatio-temporal reasoning that future research must address.
paper.ai_summary: Vision-Language Models struggle with domain adaptation in specialized spatio-temporal video grounding tasks, highlighting limitations in zero-shot generalization and in-context learning capabilities.

paper.title: PACE: A Proxy for Agentic Capability Evaluation
paper.summary: Evaluating LLM agents on benchmarks like SWE-Bench and GAIA can be expensive, time-consuming, and requires complex infrastructure. A single evaluation can cost thousands of dollars and take days to complete. In contrast, non-agentic LLM benchmarks that test individual capabilities (e.g., reasoning, code generation) are fast and cheap to run. In this paper, we investigate whether performance on expensive agentic benchmarks can be accurately predicted by the performance on a small, carefully selected subset of atomic evaluation instances. We introduce PACE, a framework that constructs proxy benchmarks by selecting instances from existing non-agentic evaluations whose aggregate scores most reliably predict model performances on agentic benchmarks. Given a pool of candidate instances spanning atomic capabilities, PACE fits a regression that maps a model's scores on a compact subset of source instances to its score on the target agentic benchmark. The subset itself is curated by combining two complementary instance-selection strategies, target-relevance local selection and globally informative global selection. We apply PACE to the 4 target agentic benchmarks in this paper, which yields PACE-Bench, the concrete proxy benchmark that we evaluate in the paper. Experiments across 14 models, 4 agentic benchmarks, and 19 non-agentic benchmarks show that PACE-Bench predicts agentic scores with leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) mean absolute error (MAE) under 4%, Spearman correlation above 0.80, and pairwise model-ranking accuracy around 85%, all at much less than 1% of the full agentic evaluation cost. We further analyze the selected proxy instances, revealing which skills each agentic benchmark uniquely demands. PACE enables practitioners to obtain reliable estimates of agentic performance during model development, selection, and routing, without the overhead of full agent evaluation.
paper.ai_summary: PACE is a framework that predicts expensive agentic LLM benchmark performance using a small subset of atomic evaluation instances, achieving high accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

paper.title: WARP: Weight-Space Analysis for Recovering Training Data Portfolios
paper.summary: Foundation models are routinely released to the public, yet the data recipes used to train them -- such as domain mixture weights that determine how different sources are sampled -- are rarely disclosed. This creates an access asymmetry: researchers study the resulting models but lack visibility into the training distribution that produces them. Prior works for inferring training data, such as membership inference, detect at the level of individual samples and thus cannot characterize the global composition of the training corpus. We introduce WARP, a framework that recovers a fine-tuned model's training mixtures directly from its released weights. WARP interpolates between the base and fine-tuned models using model merging, generating pseudo-checkpoints that approximate the missing training trajectory and expose a geometric footprint of the training data in the weight space. From these simulated footprints, WARP extracts geometric features and maps them to domain proportions using either a parameter-free softmax readout or an MLP projector trained on synthetic mixtures. In controlled experiments with BERT and GPT-2, WARP recovers domain mixtures with an average MAE as low as 0.046 and 0.104 respectively, outperforming membership inference and a variant with access to the true training trajectory.
paper.ai_summary: WARP is a framework that infers training data compositions from released model weights by analyzing geometric footprints in weight space through model merging and feature extraction.

paper.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
paper.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of expert demonstrations -- triplets of observations, instructions, and actions that are costly to collect at scale. We argue that this bottleneck stems from conflating two distinct learning objectives: acquiring physical competence (how to move) and acquiring semantic alignment (what to do). Crucially, only the latter requires language supervision. Building on this Decomposition Hypothesis, we propose Task-Agnostic Pretraining (TAP), a two-stage framework that first learns transferable motor priors from cheap, unlabeled interaction data -- including discarded off-task trajectories and autonomous robot play -- via a self-supervised Inverse Dynamics objective. A lightweight second stage then grounds these priors in language using minimal expert data. On the SIMPLER benchmark, TAP matches models trained on over 1M expert trajectories while using orders of magnitude less labeled data, yielding a 10% absolute gain over standard behavior cloning. On a real-world WidowX platform, TAP retains 25% success under camera perturbations where internet-scale baselines collapse to 0%, demonstrating that task-agnostic pretraining produces robust, transferable physical representations and offers a scalable path forward for Embodied AI.
paper.ai_summary: Task-Agnostic Pretraining framework trains robotic models using self-supervised inverse dynamics on unlabeled data followed by lightweight language grounding, achieving superior performance with minimal expert demonstrations.

paper.title: Denser neq Better: Limits of On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Post-Training
paper.summary: Continual post-training enables foundation models to acquire new knowledge while preserving existing capabilities. Recent work suggests that on-policy learning can mitigate forgetting, with on-policy self-distillation emerging as a particularly attractive approach. In this work, we revisit this optimistic view through self-distillation policy optimization (SDPO). Our experiments show that SDPO can accelerate in-domain specialization when teacher signals are stable and well aligned, but it struggles to generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios. In continual post-training, SDPO exhibits stronger forgetting and can even collapse, whereas on-policy reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO adapt more conservatively and better preserve prior capabilities. Further analyses reveal that denser self-distillation induces larger drift in both parameter space and response space, and can amplify high-frequency formatting artifacts through a self-reinforcing teacher--student loop. These findings suggest that on-policy data alone is insufficient for continual learning. Dense self-distillation can accelerate specialization when teacher targets are stable and token-level supervision is reliable, but it should not be treated as a default stabilizer for continual post-training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Moenupa/SDPO-CL.
paper.ai_summary: On-policy self-distillation in continual post-training accelerates in-domain specialization but fails to prevent forgetting and can collapse in out-of-distribution scenarios, indicating that on-policy data alone is insufficient for continual learning.

paper.title: DuoMem: Towards Capable On-Device Memory Agents via Dual-Space Distillation
paper.summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can solve complex procedural tasks by interacting with environments over multiple turns, but this ability typically depends on large models, long contexts, and repeated inference calls. This makes advanced memory-augmented agents difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. We introduce DuoMem, a dual-space distillation framework that transfers procedural problem-solving ability from a large teacher model to compact student models. DuoMem distils in two complementary spaces: (1)context-space distillation, which replaces student-generated memories with higher-quality teacher-generated procedural memories prepended to the student's input, and (2)parameter-space distillation, which fine-tunes lightweight LoRA adapters on successful teacher trajectories. Evaluated on ALFWorld, a challenging embodied decision-making benchmark, DuoMem boosts a 4B-parameter model from 4.3% to 77.9% task success rate, closing most of the gap to a 72B teacher model (87.1%), while adding fewer than 10M trainable parameters and only a few megabytes of pre-computed teacher memories. paper.title: Representation Distribution Matching for One-Step Visual Generation
paper.summary: We elucidate the design space of Representation Distribution Matching (RDM), our name for the paradigm that trains a one-step image generator by matching generated and reference feature distributions under frozen pretrained encoders. We identify two design axes, how the distributions are compared and the representations they are compared in, and controlled studies along them yield three findings. First, the classical MMD, which could not train convincing generators a decade ago, becomes a strong and scalable objective once estimated right. Second, the generated batch is then the operative variable, with an optimum above 2048, far beyond customary batch sizes. Third, any single representation can be gamed, driven below the real score while images stay visibly fake, so we match against a balanced battery of encoders and evaluate with SW_r14, a Sliced-Wasserstein distance over 14 encoders that is independent of the training loss and resists gaming. Combining the preferred choices yields improved RDM (iRDM): it sets the one-step state of the art on ImageNet at SW_r14 1.30, corroborated by PickScore, a human-preference proxy our objective never optimizes, which prefers it over the prior best one-step generator on 71.2% of matched samples. The same recipe post-trains the four-step FLUX.2 [klein] into a one-step generator, surpassing the four-step version on GenEval, 0.826 to 0.794, and on PickScore, 22.76 to 22.58, in 90 H200 GPU-hours. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/rdm/.
paper.ai_summary: Representation Distribution Matching enables high-quality image generation by matching feature distributions under pretrained encoders, with improved performance through optimized batch sizes and multi-encoder evaluation metrics.

paper.title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
paper.summary: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. We adapt a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model, DiffusionGemma-26B, and benchmark it against its same-size AR sibling Gemma-4-26B under an identical LoRA recipe on medical visual question answering datasets, scored by a verbosity-robust LLM judge. Diffusion matches or exceeds AR on all of them, and the finetuned model (3.8B active) is competitive with frontier vision-language models; its decoding is also 3.5-4.4x faster. Beyond this parity, the diffusion model offers a drafting capability AR lacks: any-order infill. Because the canvas is denoised bidirectionally, a radiologist can fix report fragments and have the model fill the text between them, an operation inherent to diffusion but not to autoregression, which is subpar at it. This suits real reports, which are often terse or inconsistent across clinicians and institutions.
paper.ai_summary: Diffusion language models match or exceed autoregressive models in medical visual question answering while offering faster decoding and bidirectional text editing capabilities.

paper.title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
paper.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been extended from single-domain training to multi-domain reasoning suites spanning mathematics, programming, and science. However, the training curriculum (how often each domain is sampled) is typically fixed or hand-tuned, even though reasoning skills transfer unevenly across domains. Existing learnability-based curricula adapt to where the policy is currently improving, but are blind to whether a gradient step on the selected domain benefits the remaining domains. In this paper, we propose Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC), a bandit-style online curriculum that prioritizes domains whose updates broadly benefit the rest of the training suite. TAC repurposes signals already produced by RL training: per-domain advantages capture local learnability, and projected gradients, taken from the GRPO step being computed, estimate cross-domain transferability via gradient-geometry alignment, at negligible cost (<1% wall-clock overhead). Across a six-domain reasoning suite, TAC achieves the best macro-averaged accuracy on both Qwen3-1.7B and Llama3.2-3B, outperforming proportional random sampling, a hand-designed schedule, and a learnability-only bandit, and improving over the last of these by up to 2.8 points (10% relative). Ablations show performance degrades sharply when the transferability term is removed, and TAC remains robust on imbalanced training mixtures where learnability-only curricula over-commit to dominant domains. Our findings establish cross-domain transferability as a key signal for curriculum design in multi-domain RLVR.
paper.ai_summary: Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC) improves multi-domain reinforcement learning by prioritizing domains that provide broad benefits to other domains, using gradient-geometry alignment to estimate cross-domain transferability.

existing_papers.resultEn: GPT-5.5 achieves the strongest aggregate rank score and top-two performance on all 16 environments in the EvoPolicyGym suite.
existing_papers.resultZh: GPT-5.5在EvoPolicyGym全部16个环境中取得最高综合排名分和前二位置。

existing_papers.titleEn: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
existing_papers.titleZh: AgenticSTS：长时程LLM智能体的有界内存测试平台
existing_papers.problemEn: Accumulating-context agents mix memories into an unanalyzable prompt jumble, making it hard to isolate which memory layer contributes to long-horizon decisions.
existing_papers.problemZh: 累积上下文智能体将记忆混杂成难以分析的提示堆叠，难以隔离哪个记忆层对长时程决策起作用。
existing_papers.innovationEn: A bounded contract assembles each decision from a fresh prompt via typed retrieval, enabling clean per-layer ablation; instantiated in Slay the Spire 2 requiring hundreds of tactical and strategic decisions.
existing_papers.innovationZh: 有界契约通过类型化检索为每次决策组装全新提示，实现干净的逐层消融实验；在需要数百次战术与战略决策的《斩杀尖塔2》中实例化。
existing_papers.resultEn: Adding a triggered strategic skill layer improves win rate from 3/10 to 6/10 (directional, Fisher p≈0.37); public baselines report zero wins at the same difficulty.
existing_papers.resultZh: 添加触发式战略技能层将胜率从3/10提升至6/10（方向性结果，Fisher p≈0.37）；公开基准在相同难度下胜率为零。

existing_papers.titleZh: 渐变为混合注意力模型
existing_papers.problemEn: Converting Transformers to hybrid full/linear-attention models requires choosing which layers keep full attention, but existing heuristics ignore inter-layer dependencies under a global hybrid configuration.
existing_papers.problemZh: 将Transformer转换为混合全/线性注意力模型需要选择哪些层保留全注意力，但现有启发式方法忽略了全局混合配置下的层间依赖。
existing_papers.innovationEn: FlashMorph formulates layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem, equipping each full-attention layer with a linear-attention branch and jointly optimizing gating on synthetic long-context retrieval data with a linearization regularization.
existing_papers.innovationZh: FlashMorph将层选择建模为预算约束优化问题，为每个全注意力层配置线性注意力分支，并在合成长上下文检索数据上联合优化门控，附带线性化正则化。
existing_papers.resultEn: FlashMorph discovers more effective hybrid configurations, preserving long-context recall and general benchmarks while substantially reducing layer selection cost versus prior methods.
existing_papers.resultZh: FlashMorph发现更有效的混合配置，在保持长上下文召回和通用基准性能的同时，相比现有方法大幅降低层选择成本。

existing_papers.titleEn: AgenticDataBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Data Agents
existing_papers.titleZh: AgenticDataBench：数据智能体综合评测基准
existing_papers.problemEn: LLM-based data agents lack comprehensive benchmarks that evaluate them across diverse domains with fine-grained skill-level granularity.
existing_papers.problemZh: 基于LLM的数据智能体缺乏能够跨多领域、以细粒度技能维度进行评估的综合基准。
existing_papers.innovationEn: AgenticDataBench covers 15 vertical domains (including 5 real-world fintech B2B cases), quantifies coverage by data-science skills extracted via skill-aligned hierarchical clustering from Stack Overflow solutions, and includes a systematic LLM-based task generation pipeline.
existing_papers.innovationZh: AgenticDataBench涵盖15个垂直领域（含5个真实金融科技B2B案例），通过从Stack Overflow解决方案中提取技能并进行技能对齐层次聚类来量化覆盖度，并包含系统化的LLM任务生成流水线。
existing_papers.resultEn: State-of-the-art data agents are evaluated with detailed skill-level insights, revealing gaps in practical data science automation across domains.
existing_papers.resultZh: 通过细粒度技能层面的评估揭示了当前最优数据智能体在跨领域实际数据科学自动化中的能力缺口。

existing_papers.titleEn: Multi-Resolution Flow Matching: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Staged Sampling
existing_papers.titleZh: 多分辨率流匹配：通过分阶段采样实现无需训练的扩散加速
existing_papers.problemEn: Multi-resolution diffusion strategies achieve 5× speedup but suffer from blurring or artifacts caused by upsampling in latent space with partial-region modification.
existing_papers.problemZh: 多分辨率扩散策略可实现5×加速，但在潜在空间中进行上采样并局部区域修改，会产生模糊或伪影问题。
existing_papers.innovationEn: MrFlow uses a staged low-to-high-resolution pipeline: low-res generation → pixel-space GAN super-resolution → noise injection for high-frequency resampling → high-res detail refinement, all without training or runtime identification.
existing_papers.innovationZh: MrFlow采用分阶段低分辨率到高分辨率流水线：低分辨率生成→像素空间GAN超分辨率→噪声注入以实现高频重采样→高分辨率细节精修，全程无需训练或运行时识别。
existing_papers.resultEn: MrFlow achieves 10× end-to-end acceleration on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image within a 1% OneIG gap, and up to 25× when combined with timestep distillation.
existing_papers.resultZh: MrFlow在FLUX.1-dev和Qwen-Image上实现10×端到端加速，OneIG差距在1%以内，结合时间步蒸馏可达25×加速。

existing_papers.titleEn: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
existing_papers.titleZh: WorldDirector：构建具有持久动态记忆的可控世界模拟器
existing_papers.problemEn: Existing video world models entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and require continuous visual observation to sustain object motion, losing identity when objects leave the frame.
existing_papers.problemZh: 现有视频世界模型将物理动态与像素渲染耦合，且依赖连续视觉观察来维持物体运动，物体离开画面后身份信息丢失。
existing_papers.innovationEn: WorldDirector decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation: an LLM coordinates 3D trajectories and camera movements, which then serve as control signals for video generation, preserving identity even after prolonged off-screen periods.
existing_papers.innovationZh: WorldDirector将语义运动编排与视觉生成解耦：LLM协调3D轨迹与摄像机运动，将其作为视频生成的控制信号，即使物体长时间离开画面也能保持身份信息。
existing_papers.resultEn: WorldDirector supports synthesis of complex, extended events with unprecedented controllability and persistent dynamic object memory across arbitrary viewpoints.
existing_papers.resultZh: WorldDirector支持合成复杂、长时程事件，具备前所未有的可控性，并在任意视角下保持持久的动态物体记忆。

existing_papers.titleEn: Breaking Failure Cascades: Step-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Medical Multimodal Reasoning
existing_papers.titleZh: 打破错误级联：医疗多模态推理的步感知强化学习
existing_papers.problemEn: Outcome-centric RL for clinical image reasoning suffers sparse credit assignment; early-stage reasoning failures cascade into wrong answers in 64% of error cases.
existing_papers.problemZh: 以结果为中心的临床图像推理RL奖励稀疏，早期推理失败在64%的错误案例中级联导致最终答案错误。
existing_papers.innovationEn: MRPO assigns exponentially larger penalties to tokens in early invalid reasoning steps when the final answer is incorrect, targeting the cascade source without disrupting successful reasoning paths.
existing_papers.innovationZh: MRPO在最终答案错误时对早期无效推理步骤中的token赋予指数级更大的惩罚，精准打击级联源头而不干扰成功推理路径。
existing_papers.resultEn: MRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct surpasses HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B by 2.79 points and reduces early-stage reasoning failures from 64.0% to 13.0%.
existing_papers.resultZh: MRPO在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上超越HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 2.79个点，并将早期推理失败率从64.0%降至13.0%。

existing_papers.titleEn: SkillCoach: Self-Evolving Rubrics for Evaluating and Enhancing Agentic Skill-Use
existing_papers.titleZh: SkillCoach：用于评估和增强智能体技能使用的自进化评分标准
existing_papers.problemEn: Final verifier accuracy is too coarse to evaluate agent skill-use quality; agents can pass through trial-and-error with distractor skills, skipped steps, or wrong compositions.
existing_papers.problemZh: 最终验证器准确率粒度太粗，难以评估智能体技能使用质量；智能体可能通过选择干扰技能、跳过步骤或错误组合来蒙混过关。
existing_papers.innovationEn: SkillCoach derives skill-grounded process rubrics from real rollouts covering four dimensions — skill selection, following, composition, and grounded reflection — keeping the external verifier as a separate outcome signal.
existing_papers.innovationZh: SkillCoach从真实推演中提炼技能基准过程评分标准，覆盖四个维度：技能选择、技能遵循、技能组合与技能基础反思，并将外部验证器作为独立结果信号保留。
existing_papers.resultEn: Evolved rubrics expose failures hidden by final accuracy and provide stronger supervision signals than outcome-only filtering for training improved agents.
existing_papers.resultZh: 进化后的评分标准能暴露最终准确率掩盖的失败，并比仅基于结果过滤提供更强的训练监督信号。

existing_papers.titleEn: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
existing_papers.titleZh: 基于分布感知奖励优化视觉生成模型
existing_papers.problemEn: Sample-wise RL rewards for visual generation cause reward hacking: all samples optimize toward the same direction independently, collapsing image diversity.
existing_papers.problemZh: 视觉生成中的样本级RL奖励导致奖励作弊：所有样本独立地朝同一方向优化，导致图像多样性崩溃。
existing_papers.innovationEn: Distribution-wise rewards account for the collective data distribution of generated samples, using a subset-replace strategy to efficiently estimate rewards, plus RL-optimized model-merging coefficients to reduce SDE-induced train-inference inconsistency.
existing_papers.innovationZh: 分布感知奖励考虑生成样本的整体数据分布，采用子集替换策略高效估算奖励，并通过RL优化模型合并系数以减少SDE引入的训练-推理不一致性。
existing_papers.resultEn: FID-50K improves from 8.30 to 5.77 for SiT and from 3.74 to 3.52 for EDM2, with enhanced perceptual quality while preserving sample diversity.
existing_papers.resultZh: SiT的FID-50K从8.30改善至5.77，EDM2从3.74改善至3.52，在保持样本多样性的同时提升了感知质量。

existing_papers.titleEn: Logit-Contribution Scoring Identifies Non-Literal Retrieval Heads
existing_papers.titleZh: 逻辑贡献评分识别非字面检索注意力头
existing_papers.problemEn: Existing attention-head detectors only reward literal copy-paste retrieval, missing heads that synthesize meaning non-literally via their output-value circuit.
existing_papers.problemZh: 现有注意力头检测器只奖励字面复制检索，遗漏了通过输出值电路进行非字面意义综合的注意力头。
existing_papers.innovationEn: LOCOS scores each head by projecting its OV-circuit output onto the answer-token unembedding direction, contrasting needle vs. off-needle positions in a single forward pass.
existing_papers.innovationZh: LOCOS通过将每个头的OV电路输出投影到答案token的反嵌入方向上进行评分，在单次前向传播中对比目标位置与非目标位置。
existing_papers.resultEn: Ablating 50 LOCOS-selected heads on Qwen3-8B collapses ROUGE-L from 0.401 to 0.000 on NoLiMa, while the strongest baseline still retains 0.292.
existing_papers.resultZh: 对Qwen3-8B消融50个LOCOS选出的注意力头，NoLiMa上的ROUGE-L从0.401崩溃至0.000，而最强基线仍保留0.292。

existing_papers.titleEn: From SRA to Self-Flow: Data Augmentation or Self-Supervision?
existing_papers.titleZh: 从SRA到Self-Flow：数据增强还是自监督？
existing_papers.problemEn: Self-Flow's improvement over SRA in diffusion transformer training is attributed to token interactions between different noise levels, but this mechanism has never been rigorously tested.
existing_papers.problemZh: Self-Flow相对SRA在扩散Transformer训练中的提升被归因于不同噪声级别间的token交互，但这一机制从未经过严格验证。
existing_papers.innovationEn: Attention Separation preserves the dual-timestep input of Self-Flow but blocks cross-noise-level attention; removing token interaction doesn't degrade performance, revealing data augmentation — not interaction — drives the gain.
existing_papers.innovationZh: 注意力分离保留Self-Flow的双时间步输入，但阻断跨噪声级别的注意力；去除token交互后性能不降反升，揭示是数据增强而非交互驱动了提升。
existing_papers.resultEn: Attention Separation matches or improves Self-Flow while providing extra augmentation by splitting images into multiple effective training parts.
existing_papers.resultZh: 注意力分离在不低于Self-Flow性能的同时，通过将图像拆分为多个有效训练部分进一步提供数据增强效果。

existing_papers.titleEn: AGVBench: A Reliability-Oriented Benchmark of Data Augmentation for Vein Recognition
existing_papers.titleZh: AGVBench：面向可靠性的静脉识别数据增强基准
existing_papers.problemEn: Augmentation strategies designed for natural images often disrupt fine-grained vein topology essential for biometric identity, and accuracy-centric evaluation misses adversarial vulnerabilities.
existing_papers.problemZh: 为自然图像设计的增强策略常破坏生物识别身份所需的精细静脉拓扑，且以准确率为中心的评估遗漏对抗安全漏洞。
existing_papers.innovationEn: AGVBench evaluates 30 augmentation strategies on 5 public vein datasets with 7 backbone architectures, assessing accuracy, calibration quality, and adversarial robustness in one standardized protocol.
existing_papers.innovationZh: AGVBench在5个公开静脉数据集上用7种骨干架构评估30种增强策略，在统一标准协议下同时评估准确率、校准质量与对抗鲁棒性。
existing_papers.resultEn: Multi-image mixing achieves the strongest recognition performance but is poorly calibrated and adversarially vulnerable, revealing a critical accuracy-security gap in biometric augmentation.
existing_papers.resultZh: 多图混合方法准确率最高，但校准性差且易受对抗攻击，揭示了生物特征增强中关键的准确率-安全性矛盾。

existing_papers.titleEn: InstanceControl: Controllable Complex Image Generation without Instance Labeling
existing_papers.titleZh: InstanceControl：无需实例标注的复杂图像可控生成
existing_papers.problemEn: Controllable image generation in complex multi-instance scenes suffers attribute confusion, and existing fixes require labor-intensive manual instance labeling.
existing_papers.problemZh: 复杂多实例场景中的可控图像生成存在属性混淆问题，而现有解决方案需要耗费大量人工进行实例标注。
existing_papers.innovationEn: InstanceControl uses a VLM to automatically parse instance descriptions from text prompts and predict instance masks from visual conditions, with an adaptive mask refinement strategy that dynamically corrects noisy masks during generation.
existing_papers.innovationZh: InstanceControl利用VLM自动从文本提示中解析实例描述并从视觉条件中预测实例掩码，并通过自适应掩码精修策略在生成过程中动态修正噪声掩码。
existing_papers.resultEn: InstanceControl outperforms state-of-the-art methods with superior fidelity and precise instance-level control, eliminating any need for manual instance labeling.
existing_papers.resultZh: InstanceControl在保真度和精确实例级控制方面优于最新方法，且无需任何人工实例标注。

existing_papers.titleEn: When Search Agents Should Ask: DiscoBench for Clarification-Aware Deep Search
existing_papers.titleZh: 搜索智能体何时应主动提问：面向澄清感知深度搜索的DiscoBench
existing_papers.problemEn: Existing search benchmarks assume complete, explicit queries, but real-world requests are often vague or incorrect, causing search agents to propagate ambiguity along multi-step reasoning chains.
existing_papers.problemZh: 现有搜索基准假设查询完整且明确，但现实请求常模糊或有误，导致搜索智能体在多步推理链中传播歧义。
existing_papers.innovationEn: DiscoBench provides 211 samples across 11 domains covering 4 ambiguity types, with a multi-turn user simulator evaluating agents on task utility, ambiguity detection, interaction strategy, and cost efficiency.
existing_papers.innovationZh: DiscoBench提供涵盖11个领域、4种歧义类型的211个样本，配备多轮交互用户模拟器，从任务效用、歧义检测、交互策略和成本效率四个维度评估智能体。
existing_papers.resultEn: Experiments show ambiguity detection and clarification are distinct capabilities; repeatedly searching instead of asking for clarification often underperforms even direct guessing.
existing_papers.resultZh: 实验表明歧义检测与澄清提问是不同能力；反复搜索而不主动提问往往不如直接猜测，揭示了当前搜索智能体的关键能力缺口。
